g.text: Interactive learning activity — click labels in the word bank to explore

svg.text: Learn flower anatomy by exploring labels.

g.text: 1. Look at the numbered drop slots.
2. Read the labels in the word bank.
3. Click a label to highlight the part.
4. Check the answer using the button.

svg.text: Click any label to highlight its flower part

g.text: • Sepals — green small leaves under petals
• Receptacle — base that connects to stem
Click a label to see its flower part glow in gold.
You can explore the flower anatomy again.
Click labels to highlight and learn.
